fields.label: Partner Type
fields.description: Select the connector family that drives the connection hints below.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The latest recorded connection test result.

fields.label: Checked On
fields.description: Timestamp of the latest recorded connection test.

fields.label: Latest Error
fields.description: Most recent failure details from the latest connection test.

fields.label: Host
fields.description: Hostname or IP address of the partner system. For SQL Server use the server name without the database.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: Database port. Leave blank to use the connector default.

fields.label: Database
fields.description: Database or catalog name used by the connector.

fields.label: Trust Server Certificate
fields.description: Enable only for trusted internal certificates or self-signed SQL Server endpoints.

fields.label: Charset
fields.description: Used by Firebird connections when an explicit charset is needed.

fields.label: Connection Options
fields.description: Optional driver-specific connection options, one per line or JSON. Add sensitive option keys to Secret Fields so exports mask them.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.description: IANA time zone used when the partner stores or returns naive datetimes, for example Europe/Berlin.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Login name used for database or API authentication when the selected auth type requires it.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: API key or access token provided by the upstream system.

fields.label: API Secret
fields.description: Secret value paired with the API key.

fields.label: Certificate Path
fields.description: Filesystem path to the client certificate.

fields.label: Connection Notes
fields.description: Document setup constraints, special driver notes, and operator guidance.

fields.label: Secret Fields
fields.description: Field names or connection option keys to mask when exporting, one per line.
